name: robot
description: A little ASCII robot that walks, dances and plays above your Claude Code prompt — and in your terminal

contextFire.title: Context on fire (default on)
contextFire.description: When the context passes the fire level, the robot's head catches fire and it reminds you to /compact. Off keeps the normal animations always.

hotAt.title: Fire at (% context, default 25)
hotAt.description: Context usage, in percent, at which the robot's head catches fire. Empty means 25.

size.title: Robot size (default L)
size.description: L is the full robot. M and S draw it two cells narrower; in the desktop app M also scales it to 80% and S to 65%.
